pr.title: Replace OffsetOf by an actual sum of calls to intrinsic.
pr.description:
This PR changes the way we compute the value of the `offset_of!` macro in MIR. The current implementation uses a dedicated MIR rvalue.

This PR proposes to replace it by an inline constant which sums calls to a new intrinsic `offset_of(variant index, field index)`. The desugaring is done at THIR building time, easier that doing it on MIR.

The new intrinsic is only meant to be used by const-eval. LLVM codegen will refuse to generate code for it.

We replace:
```rust
a = offset_of!(T, Variant1.Field1.Variant2.Field2);
```

By:
```rust
a = const {constant#n};

{constant#n}: usize = {
    _1 = offset_of::<T>(index of Variant1, index of Field1);
    _2 = offset_of::<U>(index of Variant2, index of Field2); // Where T::Variant1::Field1 has type U
    _0 = _1 + _2
}
```

The second commit modifies intrinsic const checking to take `allow_internal_unstable` into account. The new intrinsic should only be called from stable `offset_of!` macro. The intrinsic itself is unstable, const-unstable, but `rustc_intrinsic_const_stable_indirect`.

Fixes rust-lang/rust#123959
Fixes rust-lang/rust#125680
Fixes rust-lang/rust#129425
Fixes rust-lang/rust#136175

```rust
}
```

Upd.: additionaly, it does not ICE with -Znext-solver enabled for the first provided case, but not the second.

@rustbot label +F-generic_const_exprs

analysis.summary: offset_of! lowering changed from a dedicated MIR `Rvalue::NullaryOp(NullOp::OffsetOf(fields), ty)` to a const block that sums calls to a new `offset_of::<T>(variant: u32, field: u32)` intrinsic. Const-prop passes that previously folded the dedicated OffsetOf rvalue must stop handling it; instead the const block is evaluated, folding to a constant only when the container is concrete, while generic containers remain opaque.
analysis.originalLogic: Before this PR, DataflowConstProp, GVN, and KnownPanicsLint recognized `Rvalue::NullaryOp(NullOp::OffsetOf(fields), ty)` and computed the layout offset directly. In DataflowConstProp: `NullOp::OffsetOf(fields) => self` then `.offset_of_subfield(self.typing_env, layout, fields.iter())` and `FlatSet::Elem(Scalar::from_target_usize(val, &self.tcx))`. In GVN: `NullOp::OffsetOf(fields) => self` then `.offset_of_subfield(self.typing_env(), arg_layout, fields.iter())` and `ImmTy::from_uint(val, ty).into()`. In KnownPanicsLint: `NullOp::OffsetOf(fields) => self` then `.offset_of_subfield(self.typing_env, op_layout, fields.iter())` and `ImmTy::from_scalar(Scalar::from_target_usize(val, self), layout).into()`.
analysis.incorrectTransformation: The stale transformation is the pre-PR assumption that every `offset_of!` reaches these passes as one `Rvalue::NullaryOp(NullOp::OffsetOf(fields), container_ty)` and can be replaced by a single folded `usize` constant computed from that container type. After the lowering change, `NullOp::OffsetOf` no longer exists: the expression is a const block summing one intrinsic call per path hop, e.g. `offset_of::<Alpha>(const 0_u32, const 2_u32)` plus `offset_of::<Beta>(const 0_u32, const 0_u32)`, wrapped in `const {constant#n}`. Retaining or implementing direct OffsetOf folding is therefore inapplicable; a pass must instead leave the const block/intrinsic expression to evaluation and may only replace it with a final constant when the const is monomorphic. The old direct-fold logic also could not represent the per-hop sum of offsets for `offset_of!(Alpha, z.0)`.
analysis.inputDomain: Rust programs using `std::mem::offset_of!` on structs, enum variants, nested tuple/struct fields, `#[repr(C)]` containers, generic containers, and containers with unsized tails; compiled at MIR optimization levels where DataflowConstProp/GVN/KnownPanicsLint run, or at `-Zmir-opt-level=0` to inspect the generated const blocks.
analysis.trigger: A const block produced by `offset_of!` is encountered by DataflowConstProp/GVN/KnownPanicsLint. If its container type is fully concrete, the block's `offset_of::<T>(variant, field)` calls and additions can be const-evaluated and the whole const block replaced by a concrete `usize`. If the container is generic (e.g. `Gamma<T>` or `Delta<T>`), layout depends on `T` and the const block must not be folded to a constant.
preconditions: The expression originates from `std::mem::offset_of!`, which now expands to `const { builtin # offset_of(...) }` and is desugared at THIR-building time.
The new intrinsic is declared `pub const fn offset_of<T: PointeeSized>(variant: u32, field: u32) -> usize` with `#[lang = "offset_of"]` and `#[rustc_intrinsic_const_stable_indirect]`.
The MIR rvalue model no longer has `NullOp::OffsetOf`; `Rvalue::NullaryOp` carries only `NullOp::RuntimeChecks`, with no separate type operand.
For folding to a constant, the const block's container types must be concrete enough for layout evaluation; generic containers leave the const block in place.
pitfalls: Nested field paths are lowered as a sum of per-hop intrinsic calls, not as one flattened `(VariantIdx, FieldIdx)` list. For `offset_of!(Alpha, z.0)`, the test expects `offset_of::<Alpha>(const 0_u32, const 2_u32)` plus `offset_of::<Beta>(const 0_u32, const 0_u32)` and an `AddWithOverflow`; folding only the first call is wrong.

Do not fold a generic const block such as `const generic::<T>::{constant#0}` to a concrete offset; its layout depends on `T`. The updated GVN expectations leave these as `_1 = const generic::<T>::{constant#0}`.
`Rvalue::NullaryOp` no longer carries a `Ty`; visitors and type checkers that previously called `visit_ty` for the nullary operand must stop doing so.
The new `offset_of` intrinsic is intended only for const evaluation; the PR states `LLVM codegen will refuse to generate code for it`, and it is wrapped in a const block.

Const checking only honors `span.allows_unstable` (`#[allow_internal_unstable]`) when the callee is const-stable: `if self.span.allows_unstable(feature) && is_const_stable { return; }`, avoiding bypassing recursive stability.

`offset_of!` now emits a const block, so lint/typeck tests that matched the old direct `offset_of` expression needed updating (e.g. the unused-result detection now looks through `ExprKind::ConstBlock`).
analysis.testStrategy: Use MIR dump tests. At `-Zmir-opt-level=0`, `tests/mir-opt/building/offset_of.rs` checks the generated const bodies directly: e.g. `_0 = offset_of::<Alpha>(const 0_u32, const 0_u32)`, enum `_0 = offset_of::<Blah>(const 1_u32, const 1_u32)`, and nested `AddWithOverflow` for `z.0`/`z.1`. Use `//@ test-mir-pass: GVN` diffs to check constant propagation: concrete `const concrete::{constant#0}` becomes `_1 = const 4_usize`, while generic `const generic::<T>::{constant#0}` stays unfolded. Add UI tests for `offset_of!` inside array lengths (`tests/ui/offset-of/inside-array-length.rs`, regression for ICEs #123959, #125680, #129425, #136175) and for unsized tails (`tests/ui/offset-of/offset-of-unsized.rs`).
evidence: Replace OffsetOf by an actual sum of calls to intrinsic.
This PR proposes to replace it by an inline constant which sums calls to a new intrinsic `offset_of(variant index, field index)`.
The new intrinsic is only meant to be used by const-eval. LLVM codegen will refuse to generate code for it.
